status: locked: adding a primary classification requires explicit owner approval

neutralChromaCeiling.meaning: A color with C at or below this value behaves as a neutral. It may be visibly tinted.

neutralMaxChromaticArea.meaning: Largest share of declared area that colors above the neutral chroma ceiling may occupy in a Neutral direction.

vibrantAnchor.meaning: A vibrant direction needs at least one chromatic foundation, primary, secondary or accent color meeting both floors. Relative chroma is C divided by the sRGB maximum C at the same L and h.

foundationPolarity.method: Compare the WCAG contrast of the foundation HEX against #000000 and #FFFFFF. Black winning means a light foundation. White winning means a dark foundation.
foundationPolarity.meaning: Foundations with L inside the review band pass the measured test but need a curator to confirm that they read as light or dark.
foundationPolarity.evidence: project-decision built on a WCAG formula

classifications.label: Neutral
classifications.definition: An achromatic foundation of white, black, gray and their variations, where color is absent or confined to a small accent.
classifications.test: The foundation has C <= neutralChromaCeiling AND chromatic colors occupy <= neutralMaxChromaticArea of declared area.
includes: Pure and tinted whites, grays and blacks
One restrained accent within the area budget
excludes: Chromatic color carrying more than the area budget

classifications.label: Light + Vibrant
classifications.definition: A predominantly light foundation paired with vibrant, saturated color that carries the identity.
classifications.test: Not Neutral AND foundation polarity is light AND at least one vibrantAnchor exists.
includes: White or tinted-white grounds with saturated color
Light chromatic grounds with a saturated anchor
excludes: Palettes where every chromatic color falls below the vibrant anchor (see open question 1 in README.md)

classifications.label: Dark + Vibrant
classifications.definition: A predominantly dark foundation paired with vibrant, saturated color that carries the identity.
classifications.test: Not Neutral AND foundation polarity is dark AND at least one vibrantAnchor exists.
includes: Black or near-black grounds with saturated color
Deep chromatic grounds with a saturated anchor
excludes: Palettes where every chromatic color falls below the vibrant anchor (see open question 1 in README.md)
